additional_info.subject: ID0472706-DC/Si-D/SE-[Y2/S3313581528001] Charger Communication Failure CRM:03288000151
additional_info.body:
Dear Etka,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, and after checking the charger, we see that the charger is offline.
The SCB connection is offline, connected to our system.
Could you clarify what the exact issue is? And is the charger still working properly and optimal.
We hope to resolve the issue as soon as possible.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0472706-DC/Si-D/SE-[Y2/S3313581528001] Charger Communication Failure CRM:03288000151
additional_info.body:
Hi
I have talked to the customer and got the following information.
Charger is offline in both SCB and OCPP backend. The customer visit the site and tried a local rebott. The charger is getting stuck at 30% and after a while the charger reboots again.
I am waiting to see if the charger enters fail safe mode and comes online in SCB.
If not another site visit is needed. So we can troubleshoot what is causing this.
Kind regards Magnus
